streams.reasoning: Chemistry Plan specifies single stream logic. Concentration 0.1 M from Engineering Design Calculations Step 1. Flow rate 0.5 mL/min derived from target residence time and reactor volume.

mixing_order_reasoning: Chemistry Plan indicates all reagents can be premixed. Static mixer ensures homogeneity before entering heated zone, addressing mass-transfer limitations (Da=70) identified in calculations.
pre_reactor_steps: Sparging with Nitrogen for 15 minutes to remove dissolved oxygen (Chemistry Plan: deoxygenation_required=true, Pd sensitive to O2)
Pre-heating coil to 50°C to minimize thermal shock
post_reactor_steps: Quench with water (standard workup for Suzuki)
chemistry_notes: Suzuki-Miyaura coupling is thermally driven, not photochemical. Batch used microwave heating; flow uses thermal oil bath/heater. Reaction is oxygen-sensitive; strict inert atmosphere required. Engineering calculations indicate mass-transfer limitation (Da=70), necessitating efficient mixing. Residence time reduced from 10 min (batch) to 0.6 min (flow) based on kinetic intensification factor. No light source required.

reasoning_per_field.residence_time_min: Engineering Calculation Step 2 suggests 0.6 min (range 0.3-1.0 min) for 18x intensification. Analogies used 12-60 min but were photochemical/slower kinetics. Thermal Suzuki is faster. 0.6 min is within calculated range.
reasoning_per_field.residence_time_basis: Single phase liquid system. Basis is liquid volume / liquid flow.
reasoning_per_field.temperature_C: 50°C matches batch condition. DMF bp 153°C allows operation at 50°C without BPR.
reasoning_per_field.BPR_bar: Engineering Calculation Step 8: BPR not required (T=50°C << bp=153°C). Set to 0.
reasoning_per_field.tubing_material: PFA preferred for thermal stability and chemical resistance to DMF/Pd. FEP is also acceptable but PFA has higher temp rating. No light transmission needed.
reasoning_per_field.concentration_M: 0.1 M from Engineering Calculation Step 1. Analogies used 0.05-0.5 M. 0.1 M balances solubility and viscosity.
reasoning_per_field.reactor_volume_mL: Calculated as V = t * Q = 0.6 min * 0.5 mL/min = 0.3 mL. Closest standard coil size.
reasoning_per_field.tubing_ID_mm: 1.0 mm from Engineering Calculation Step 3. Balances pressure drop and axial dispersion (Pe=7 warning, but acceptable for short residence time).
reasoning_per_field.flow_rate_mL_min: 0.5 mL/min derived from V=0.3mL and t=0.6min. Matches Engineering Calculation Step 3.
